description: Planning templates; no work or test results asserted.

tasks.task: Inventory board, buttons, resistors, data cable, power and serial driver
tasks.doneWhen: Exact part list, pinout link and powered wiring check recorded.

tasks.task: Confirm Spacetime environment, runtime versions and access
tasks.doneWhen: Minimal isolated module is reachable with separate test identities.

tasks.task: Confirm Nemotron endpoint, supported model and quota
tasks.doneWhen: Real access classified available/unavailable; no key copied into evidence.

tasks.task: Agree v1 envelopes, errors, state transitions and identifier ownership
tasks.doneWhen: Shared schema and examples accepted by all three implementers.

tasks.task: Create monorepo, lockfiles, scripts and example configuration
tasks.doneWhen: Clean install, typecheck and fixture command work; secrets ignored.

tasks.task: Implement firmware debounce, selection and serial event acknowledgement
tasks.doneWhen: Bounce cannot produce multiple accepted logical requests.

tasks.task: Implement SQLite schema, migrations and atomic outbox writes
tasks.doneWhen: Commit precedes accepted indicator; failed writes show failure.

tasks.task: Implement serial parsing and durable event-to-request mapping
tasks.doneWhen: Replayed device event maps to the existing request after service restart.

tasks.task: Implement station status display and exact LED meanings
tasks.doneWhen: Saved, delivered, acknowledged and complete are distinguishable without color alone.

tasks.task: Implement authoritative request/event tables and submit reducer
tasks.doneWhen: Same ID/body is idempotent; conflicting body is rejected.

tasks.task: Enforce identity roles and station ownership server-side
tasks.doneWhen: Station cannot read another station or perform coordinator actions.

tasks.task: Implement retry, backoff and receipt persistence
tasks.doneWhen: Lost receipt and reconnect do not create duplicate effects.

tasks.task: Implement lifecycle reducers, one-item manual proposal/approval with atomic reservation, and version reconciliation
tasks.doneWhen: Invalid transitions rejected; one-item assignment/settlement validated; stale updates cannot regress terminal state.

tasks.task: Build queue/detail UI, acknowledgement and unresolved filters
tasks.doneWhen: Pending/unacknowledged/unmatched states remain independently visible.

tasks.task: Wire status subscriptions back through bridge to physical indicators
tasks.doneWhen: Explicit coordinator action changes correct station request status.

tasks.task: Run G2 physical/offline/restart end-to-end demonstration
tasks.doneWhen: Save→retry→single request→ack→manual assignment→complete video and IDs captured.

tasks.task: Seed synthetic requests, resources, volunteers and role identities
tasks.doneWhen: Repeatable isolated scenario, including scarce and incompatible resources.

tasks.task: Implement deterministic eligibility graph and baseline
tasks.doneWhen: Hard constraints tested; FCFS baseline operates on same inputs.

tasks.task: Implement bounded allocation and unmatched reason taxonomy
tasks.doneWhen: Fixed snapshot gives repeatable feasible assignments and reasons.

tasks.task: Extend the existing manual proposal/approval path to immutable snapshots, bounded bulk plans and worker runs
tasks.doneWhen: Two simultaneous approvals cannot overbook last resource; manual and optimized paths share validation.

tasks.task: Build comparison/approval UI with stale-plan handling
tasks.doneWhen: Human sees capacity, reasons, age and exact changes before approval.

tasks.task: Implement volunteer assigned-task view and completion permission
tasks.doneWhen: Assigned volunteer sees only permitted task fields and actions.

tasks.task: Build bounded read/solve/compare/propose tool handlers
tasks.doneWhen: Schemas, size limits and caller authorization enforced.

tasks.task: Implement real Nemotron loop and sanitized trace
tasks.doneWhen: Actual model/tool sequence recorded with no approve/dispatch tool.

tasks.task: Implement timeout, malformed-output and quota fallback
tasks.doneWhen: Deterministic workflow remains available during every model failure.

tasks.task: Verify injection resistance and explanation grounding
tasks.doneWhen: Untrusted content cannot change tools, permissions or resource facts.

tasks.task: Deploy isolated demo backend and static UI; document endpoints
tasks.doneWhen: Fresh browser connects, authorized access works, restart steps documented.

tasks.task: Test storage, transport and board-reset fault matrix
tasks.doneWhen: Tests T01–T12 have measured outcomes and retained evidence.

tasks.task: Test permissions, plan races and allocation invariants
tasks.doneWhen: Critical negative tests pass or release is blocked.

tasks.task: Conduct keyboard, labels, focus and physical usability review
tasks.doneWhen: Tested controls usable without color/mouse; issues logged honestly.

tasks.task: Run repeatable performance and baseline experiment
tasks.doneWhen: Sample size, raw timings, fixtures and implementation version recorded.

tasks.task: Verify clean-machine setup and recovery instructions
tasks.doneWhen: A teammate follows instructions without undocumented owner steps.

tasks.task: Review secrets, dependency licenses, attribution and public content
tasks.doneWhen: Public artifacts contain synthetic data and no credentials.

tasks.task: Capture 90-second demo plus honest offline fallback
tasks.doneWhen: Playable video shows actual hardware and human approval.

tasks.task: Resolve sponsor ledger and all-team submission requirements
tasks.doneWhen: Each selected entry maps to real evidence; cap treatment confirmed.

tasks.task: Freeze tested commit and verify actual submission
tasks.doneWhen: Public links open; final Submitted status and commit recorded.

tasks.task: Prepare expo kit, reset seed and handoff cards
tasks.doneWhen: Spare cable, power, offline video and recovery instructions available.

tasks.task: Return borrowed hardware and record unresolved follow-up
tasks.doneWhen: Accessories checked and return acknowledged by loan desk.

tests.name: Online path
tests.steps: Press confirm once; acknowledge, approve a valid one-item assignment, and complete using authorized UI
tests.expected: One request; distinct local-save, delivered, acknowledged, assigned and completed meanings. Video plus request/event IDs.

tests.name: Offline save
tests.steps: Disconnect uplink; create three requests
tests.expected: Three durable local records; explicitly not delivered. Local rows and station video.

tests.name: Service restart
tests.steps: Stop bridge after save; restart while offline
tests.expected: Same IDs recovered; no new request identity. Before/after rows.

tests.name: Crash before commit
tests.steps: Inject failure before SQLite transaction commits
tests.expected: No accepted/saved indication; no phantom durable record. Fault log and display.

tests.name: Crash after commit
tests.steps: Kill service after commit before device acceptance reply
tests.expected: Retry resolves same event/request; one accepted request. Mapping and row count.

tests.name: Lost server receipt
tests.steps: Drop response after server transaction; retry
tests.expected: One server request and creation effect; replayed receipt/status. Server audit.

tests.name: Conflicting retry
tests.steps: Resend existing request ID with changed category
tests.expected: Conflict; original unchanged; visible review condition. Rejection code and record.

tests.name: Bounce and intent
tests.steps: Inject rapid switch transitions, then two deliberate presses
tests.expected: Bounce debounced; deliberate accepted requests have different IDs. Serial capture.

tests.name: Board reset
tests.steps: Reset MCU during unaccepted and accepted event cases
tests.expected: Defined session identity behavior; no false recovery/duplicate promise. Video and mapping.

tests.name: Storage failure
tests.steps: Make test database unwritable or inject disk-full result
tests.expected: No false saved indicator; operator error; queued records retained. Error and recovery log.

tests.name: Reordered updates
tests.steps: Deliver newer completion then stale acknowledgement
tests.expected: Status never regresses; version comparison recorded. State snapshot.

tests.name: Clock skew
tests.steps: Shift station clock substantially; restore it
tests.expected: IDs/order/approval freshness remain valid; no negative claimed latency. Version and timing logs.

tests.name: Reconnect backlog
tests.steps: Queue at least 20 requests; reconnect with repeated drops
tests.expected: Accepted ID set equals unique delivered set after recovery; no silent drops. ID-set diff.

tests.name: Unauthorized submit
tests.steps: Unregistered identity submits station request
tests.expected: Server denies; no new row or event. Reducer failure and counts.

tests.name: Cross-station read
tests.steps: Station A attempts Station B status subscription/query
tests.expected: No forbidden record fields returned. Both identity traces.

tests.name: Role escalation
tests.steps: Station/worker invokes acknowledge, approve, resource edit
tests.expected: Every privileged action denied server-side. Negative test report.

tests.name: Volunteer scope
tests.steps: Volunteer reads/completes unassigned request
tests.expected: Denied; assigned allowed case succeeds. Read and mutation evidence.

tests.name: Invalid transitions
tests.steps: Complete an unacknowledged/unassigned request as restricted actor
tests.expected: Transition rejected under defined policy; previous state retained. Audit/row check.

tests.name: Capacity exhaustion
tests.steps: More eligible requests than resource slots
tests.expected: Capacity never exceeded; residual requests remain visibly unmatched. Solver output.

tests.name: Suitability constraint
tests.steps: Accessible need with unsuitable available resource
tests.expected: Incompatible edge excluded; precise reason shown. Input and candidate-edge trace.

tests.name: Availability
tests.steps: Resource unavailable in current batch/window
tests.expected: No allocation to it; explicit reason. Scenario result.

tests.name: Stale proposal
tests.steps: Generate plan; modify resource/request; approve old plan; also test expired ten-minute TTL
tests.expected: Approval rejected; regeneration requires another human review; no partial booking. Epoch/version/time evidence.

tests.name: Concurrent approvals
tests.steps: Two coordinator clients approve plans using last slot
tests.expected: At most one succeeds; loser refreshes with error; no negative capacity. Concurrent log.

tests.name: Approval replay
tests.steps: Repeat approval operation after ambiguous connection result
tests.expected: Same resulting assignment/reservation; no double consumption. Idempotency trace.

tests.name: Release semantics
tests.steps: Complete/cancel water and charging assignments; repeat operations
tests.expected: Water completion consumes; charging completion releases; cancellation releases; each effect occurs once. Ledger diff.

tests.name: Determinism
tests.steps: Solve same canonical snapshot repeatedly with input order shuffled
tests.expected: Same canonical plan and reasons; invariant checks clean. Hash/output comparison.

tests.name: Empty/infeasible
tests.steps: Supply zero requests, zero resources, impossible requirements
tests.expected: Valid bounded result, no exception loop or invented resource. Fixture results.

tests.name: Malformed model output
tests.steps: Inject unknown tool, oversized args, invalid numbers and repeated tool requests
tests.expected: Tool blocked; maximum eight sequential calls, one repair and 60-second run bound enforced; no privileged mutation. Trace.

tests.name: Prompt injection
tests.steps: Put instructions to approve/ignore rules in request text
tests.expected: Treated as data; no unauthorized tool/action. Trace plus server state.

tests.name: Model outage
tests.steps: Force timeout, rate limit, invalid credentials and provider error
tests.expected: Queue/ack/manual allocation usable; bounded retries; no fabricated live result. Video/log.

tests.name: Explanation check
tests.steps: Compare model explanation to returned assignments/reasons
tests.expected: Unsupported facts suppressed or flagged; source IDs retained. Review checklist.

tests.name: Keyboard flow
tests.steps: Complete coordinator flow using keyboard only
tests.expected: Logical focus, visible focus, labels and recoverable errors. Manual checklist/video.

tests.name: Non-color status
tests.steps: View in grayscale and read station labels
tests.expected: Four meanings identifiable through words/patterns; no color-only dependency. Photos.

tests.name: Physical usability
tests.steps: Consenting teammates try selection, confirm and correction
tests.expected: No forced timing; accidental-input handling clear; limitations recorded. Observations.

tests.name: Secret/privacy scan
tests.steps: Scan repository, build output, logs, video and screenshots
tests.expected: No tokens, private endpoints with credentials, or real resident records. Review record.

tests.name: Clean recovery
tests.steps: Another teammate follows setup/reset/restart runbook
tests.expected: Reproduces same seeded demonstration and recognizes offline states. Timed checklist.
